title: Coupled Local and Global World Models for Efficient First Order RL
abstract: arXiv:2602.06219v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: World models offer a promising avenue for more faithfully capturing complex dynamics, including contacts and non-rigidity, as well as complex sensory information, such as visual perception, in situations where standard simulators struggle. However, these models are computationally complex to evaluate, posing a challenge for popular RL approaches that have been successfully used with simulators to solve complex locomotion tasks but yet struggle with manipulation. This paper introduces a method that bypasses simulators entirely, training RL policies inside world models learned from robots' interactions with real environments. At its core, our approach enables policy training with large-scale diffusion models via a novel decoupled first-order gradient (FoG) method: a full-scale world model generates accurate forward trajectories, while a lightweight latent-space surrogate approximates its local dynamics for efficient gradient comp

translated_title: 用于高效一阶强化学习的局部与全局耦合世界模型
translated_abstract: 世界模型为更真实地捕捉复杂动力学（包括接触和非刚性）以及复杂感知信息（如视觉感知）提供了一个有前景的途径，尤其是在标准模拟器难以应对的场景中。然而，这些模型的计算评估非常复杂，这给流行的强化学习方法带来了挑战——这些方法虽然已在模拟器中成功用于解决复杂的运动任务，但在操作任务中仍然表现不佳。本文提出了一种完全绕过模拟器的方法，在从机器人与真实环境交互中学习到的世界模型内训练强化学习策略。我们方法的核心在于通过一种新颖的解耦一阶梯度方法实现基于大规模扩散模型的策略训练：完整规模的世界模型生成精确的前向轨迹，而轻量级的潜空间代理模型近似其局部动力学，以实现高效的梯度计算。
tldr: 提出一种新颖的解耦一阶梯度（FoG）方法，通过耦合全局扩散世界模型与轻量级局部潜空间代理模型，使强化学习策略能够直接在从真实机器人交互中学到的世界模型内高效训练，完全摆脱对模拟器的依赖。
en_tdlr: A novel decoupled first-order gradient (FoG) method couples a full-scale diffusion world model with a lightweight latent-space surrogate, enabling efficient RL policy training inside world models learned from real robot interactions while bypassing simulators entirely.
